acceptance: A new test in `AddPlacedObjectCommandValidatorTests` validates an `AddPlacedObjectCommand` whose `Kind` is `(ObjectKind)999` with `KindIsInEnumOnlyValidator` (base `:170-179`) and asserts that `IsValid` is false. That same test asserts that the validation errors include one whose `PropertyName` is `nameof(AddPlacedObjectCommand.Kind)`.

For injection `<name>` editing file F: (1) copy F to `<scratch>/pre-<name>/` and apply exactly the named edit, at the named site and nowhere else; (2) run `dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DungeonMaster.Tests.Application.Features.Dungeons.Validators.AddPlacedObjectCommandValidatorTests."` and save the full output to `<scratch>/inject-<name>.log`; (3) restore F by copying the saved copy back, and prove the restore with `cmp` against the copy (no output, exit 0); (4) re-run the same command into `<scratch>/inject-<name>-restored.log`. The file this task modifies is CRLF throughout at final state. Counted in binary, its CR-LF pair count equals both its LF byte count and its CR byte count (lessons.md, Instrument FORM 15).
